_comment: The pinned reference implementation, used as the oracle by the differential
NOTE the release is 'edge', which ocsigen/wax REBUILDS ON EVERY PUSH to main.
The asset URL therefore serves a moving target, which is why sha256 and
upstream_commit are recorded here: fetch-reference.sh fails loudly when what
it downloads is not what this file describes, rather than silently swapping
the oracle out from under the goldens.
The npm package @wax-wasm/wax is NOT usable as the oracle: it is pinned at
0.1.0, which is 328 commits behind main, and the front end diverged heavily
over those commits (parser.mly 558 lines, output.ml 377, lexer.ml 91, plus
the whole parser_messages generator, which did not exist at 0.1.0).
_front_end_note: upstream_commit and ported_from_commit are the SAME commit: the binary is
built from exactly the sources in wax/, so there is no skew to reason about.
